crossRefs.note: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in…
When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house…
Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.
At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.
translations.bsb: Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the Philistines were there, and about three thousand men and women were on the roof watching Samson entertain them.
translations.kjv: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
translations.asv: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
